def design(feats):
    X = np.asarray(feats.x, float); y = np.asarray(feats.y, float); n, p = X.shape
    ids = list(feats.ids)
    labs = sorted(set(feats.stratum))
    S = np.ones((n, 1))
    if len(labs) > 1:
        st = np.array(feats.stratum)
        S = np.column_stack([np.ones(n)] + [(st == l).astype(float) for l in labs[1:]])

    def ll(Z):
        A = np.column_stack([S, Z]) if Z is not None and Z.shape[1] else S
        b = np.zeros(A.shape[1])
        for _ in range(30):
            eta = np.clip(A @ b, -30, 30); mu = 1 / (1 + np.exp(-eta))
            w = mu * (1 - mu) + 1e-9
            H = A.T @ (A * w[:, None]) + 1e-6 * np.eye(A.shape[1])
            step = np.linalg.solve(H, A.T @ (y - mu)); b += step
            if np.max(np.abs(step)) < 1e-7: break
        eta = np.clip(A @ b, -30, 30)
        return float(np.sum(y * eta - np.logaddexp(0, eta)))

    R = np.corrcoef(X, rowvar=False)
    sel = []; base = ll(None)
    for k in range(MAX_DRIVERS):
        alpha = (0.05 if k == 0 else 0.01) / p
        best, bj = None, -1
        for j in range(p):
            if j in sel or any(abs(R[j, s]) >= 0.95 for s in sel): continue
            v = ll(X[:, sel + [j]])
            if best is None or v > best: best, bj = v, j
        if bj < 0 or stats.chi2.sf(2 * (best - base), 1) > alpha: break
        sel.append(bj); base = best
    changed = True
    while changed and len(sel) > 1:
        changed = False
        full = ll(X[:, sel])
        pv = [stats.chi2.sf(2 * (full - ll(X[:, [s for s in sel if s != j]])), 1) for j in sel]
        w = int(np.argmax(pv))
        if pv[w] > 0.01 / p: sel.pop(w); changed = True
    prods = []
    cand = sorted(set(range(p)))
    npairs = p * (p + 1) // 2
    found = []
    for a in cand:
        for b in cand:
            if b < a or (a != b and abs(R[a, b]) >= 0.6): continue
            mains = sorted(set(sel) | {a, b})
            l0 = ll(X[:, mains])
            l1 = ll(np.column_stack([X[:, mains], X[:, a] * X[:, b]]))
            pv = stats.chi2.sf(2 * (l1 - l0), 1)
            if pv < 0.01 / npairs: found.append((pv, a, b))
    found.sort()
    drivers = [ids[j] for j in sel]
    for pv, a, b in found[:2]:
        prods.append((ids[a], ids[b]))
        for j in (a, b):
            if ids[j] not in drivers and len(drivers) < MAX_DRIVERS: drivers.append(ids[j])
    cols = tuple(dict.fromkeys(drivers))
    return Design(drivers=tuple(drivers), columns=cols, products=tuple(prods), loadings={})
